entries.sense_note: TV station or online video channel

def.short: a TV station, or a page on a video site where a person or group shares videos
def.long: A television station that shows programs, or a page on a video website like YouTube where a person or a company regularly shares videos. You can change it with the remote.

grammar.pattern: on a channel; change the channel

examples.en: What channel is the match on?
examples.tr: Maç hangi kanalda?

examples.en: Can you change the channel, please?
examples.tr: Kanalı değiştirir misin lütfen?

examples.en: Burak started a cooking channel on YouTube last year.
examples.tr: Burak geçen yıl YouTube'da bir yemek kanalı açtı.

tr.note: Türkçede su yolu da televizyon kanalı da 'kanal'dır. İngilizcede su yolu 'canal' (Suez Canal), televizyon ve YouTube kanalı 'channel' olur.

mistakes.wrong: Which canal is the match on?
mistakes.right: Which channel is the match on?
mistakes.why: Türkçede televizyon için de 'kanal' denir ve kulağa en yakın gelen 'canal' seçilir. Ama 'canal' gemilerin geçtiği su yoludur; TV kanalı 'channel' olur.

quiz.cloze: Can you change the ______? I don't want to watch the news again.

def.short: television, radio, newspapers and the internet, which give news to many people
def.long: Television, radio, newspapers, magazines and the internet, seen together as the ways that news and information reach a lot of people. It is often used with 'the': 'the media'.

examples.en: The story was all over the media.
examples.tr: Haber tüm medyada yer aldı.

examples.en: The singer rarely talks to the media.
examples.tr: Şarkıcı medyayla nadiren konuşuyor.

examples.en: The government was criticized in the media for the decision.
examples.tr: Hükümet bu karar yüzünden medyada eleştirildi.

tr.note: Genelde 'the media' biçiminde kullanılır. Fiil tekil de çoğul da olabilir: 'The media is/are...' İkisi de doğrudur.

quiz.cloze: The minister's comments got a lot of attention in the ______.

def.short: the work of collecting news and writing reports for newspapers, TV or websites
def.long: The work of finding out about events, collecting information and writing or presenting news for newspapers, magazines, television, radio or news websites.

examples.en: She studied journalism at university.
examples.tr: Üniversitede gazetecilik okudu.

examples.en: Good journalism checks the facts first.
examples.tr: İyi gazetecilik önce gerçekleri kontrol eder.

examples.en: Selim left journalism after twenty years and became a teacher.
examples.tr: Selim yirmi yıl sonra gazeteciliği bıraktı ve öğretmen oldu.

tr.note: Mesleği yapan kişi 'journalist' (gazeteci) olur. 'Journal' ise bilimsel dergi ya da günlük demektir.

quiz.cloze: Pınar studied ______ because she wanted to report the news on TV.

entries.sense_note: person in charge of a newspaper

def.short: a person in charge of a newspaper, or who checks and improves texts or videos
def.long: A person who is in charge of a newspaper, a magazine or part of one and decides what goes in it. It is also a person whose job is to check and improve texts, films or videos.

examples.en: The editor rejected my article.
examples.tr: Editör makalemi reddetti.

examples.en: Zeynep is the editor of a fashion magazine.
examples.tr: Zeynep bir moda dergisinin yayın yönetmeni.

examples.en: A good video editor can make a boring trip look exciting.
examples.tr: İyi bir video editörü sıkıcı bir geziyi heyecanlı gösterebilir.

tr.note: Gazetenin en üst sorumlusu 'editor' ya da 'editor-in-chief' (genel yayın yönetmeni) olur.

quiz.cloze: The ______ decided which stories would go on the front page of the newspaper.

def.short: a film or TV program that gives facts about real people, places or events
def.long: A film or a television or radio program that shows real people, places and events and gives facts about them, rather than telling an invented story.

examples.en: We watched a documentary about whales.
examples.tr: Balinalarla ilgili bir belgesel izledik.

examples.en: The documentary won an award at the festival.
examples.tr: Belgesel festivalde bir ödül kazandı.

examples.en: Hakan is making a documentary on life in Istanbul's old neighborhoods.
examples.tr: Hakan, İstanbul'un eski mahallelerindeki yaşam üzerine bir belgesel çekiyor.

quiz.cloze: It isn't fiction. It's a ______ that shows real events in the Amazon rainforest.

def.short: a small and useful device, usually electronic, that does one job well
def.long: A small piece of equipment, usually electronic, that does a useful job in a clever or new way. Smart watches and wireless earphones are good examples.

examples.en: My dad loves new gadgets.
examples.tr: Babam yeni elektronik aletlere bayılır.

examples.en: This little gadget tracks how many steps you walk.
examples.tr: Bu küçük alet kaç adım yürüdüğünü takip ediyor.

examples.en: The shop sells phones, cameras and other gadgets.
examples.tr: Mağaza telefon, kamera ve başka elektronik aletler satıyor.

tr.note: Elektronik olmayan küçük, pratik aletler için de kullanılır: 'kitchen gadget' (pratik mutfak aleti).

quiz.cloze: Hande loves the latest ______ like smart watches and wireless earphones.

def.short: a program that secretly copies itself and damages computers or files
def.long: A harmful computer program that copies itself and spreads from one computer to another, often through emails or downloads, and damages files or steals information.

examples.en: My laptop got a virus last week.
examples.tr: Geçen hafta dizüstü bilgisayarıma virüs bulaştı.

examples.en: Don't open that file; it might contain a virus.
examples.tr: O dosyayı açma, virüs içeriyor olabilir.

examples.en: The virus spread to thousands of computers in a few hours.
examples.tr: Virüs birkaç saat içinde binlerce bilgisayara yayıldı.

tr.note: Hastalık yapan virüs için de aynı kelime kullanılır. Bilgisayara virüs bulaşınca 'get a virus' ya da 'be infected with a virus' denir.

quiz.cloze: My computer got a ______ from a strange email, and now my files won't open.

def.short: a mistake in a computer program that makes it work in the wrong way
def.long: A mistake in the code of a computer program or app that makes it stop working or behave in the wrong way. Developers 'fix' them in updates.

grammar.pattern: a bug in sth; fix a bug

examples.en: This update fixes a few bugs.
examples.tr: Bu güncelleme birkaç hatayı düzeltiyor.

examples.en: There's a bug in the app; it closes every time I open the camera.
examples.tr: Uygulamada bir hata var, kamerayı her açtığımda kapanıyor.

examples.en: Emre spent all night trying to find the bug.
examples.tr: Emre bütün geceyi hatayı bulmaya çalışarak geçirdi.

tr.note: Asıl anlamı 'böcek'tir. Yazılımcılar Türkçede de çoğu zaman 'bug' der.

quiz.cloze: The game keeps crashing because of a ______ in the code.

def.short: a website or program that finds web pages when you type words into it
def.long: A website or computer program, like Google or Bing, that finds pages and information on the internet when you type words or a question into it.

examples.en: Google is the most popular search engine.
examples.tr: Google en popüler arama motorudur.

examples.en: I typed the question into a search engine and found the answer.
examples.tr: Soruyu bir arama motoruna yazdım ve cevabı buldum.

examples.en: Small businesses want to appear high in search engine results.
examples.tr: Küçük işletmeler arama motoru sonuçlarında üst sıralarda çıkmak istiyor.

quiz.cloze: Google is the most popular ______ in the world.

entries.sense_note: the right or way to use something

def.micro: the right or way to use
def.short: the right, chance or way to use something or to enter a place
def.long: The right, the chance or the way to use something, see something or enter a place. People often talk about 'internet access' or 'access to information'.

examples.en: Do you have internet access at home?
examples.tr: Evde internet erişimin var mı?

examples.en: Only managers have access to this file.
examples.tr: Bu dosyaya yalnızca yöneticilerin erişimi var.

examples.en: Students get free access to online books.
examples.tr: Öğrenciler internetteki kitaplara ücretsiz erişebiliyor.

tr.note: İsim olarak 'access to sth' kalıbıyla kullanılır. Fiil olarak ise 'to' almaz: 'access a file', 'access your account'.

mistakes.wrong: I can't access to my account.
mistakes.why: Türkçede 'hesabıma erişemiyorum' denir ve '-e' eki 'to' diye çevrilir. Ama fiil olan 'access' doğrudan nesne alır; 'to' yalnızca isimde gelir: 'access to my account'.

quiz.cloze: All students have free ______ to the library's online books.

def.short: a link to the internet, a phone network or between two devices
def.long: A link that lets a computer or phone use the internet or a network, or that joins two devices. If it is slow or weak, videos stop and calls break up.

grammar.pattern: a connection to sth; internet connection

examples.en: My internet connection is very slow today.
examples.tr: İnternet bağlantım bugün çok yavaş.

examples.en: We lost the connection in the middle of the call.
examples.tr: Görüşmenin ortasında bağlantı koptu.

examples.en: The hotel offers a free Wi-Fi connection in every room.
examples.tr: Otel her odada ücretsiz Wi-Fi bağlantısı sunuyor.

quiz.cloze: The video keeps stopping because my internet ______ is too slow.

entries.sense_note: person watching TV or a video

def.short: a person who watches a TV program or a video, especially one of many
def.long: A person who watches something, especially a television program or an online video. TV channels and video makers often talk about how many they have.

examples.en: The show lost a lot of viewers this year.
examples.tr: Program bu yıl çok izleyici kaybetti.

examples.en: Some viewers complained about the ending.
examples.tr: Bazı izleyiciler sondan şikâyet etti.

examples.en: The live stream had more than a million viewers.
examples.tr: Canlı yayının bir milyondan fazla izleyicisi vardı.

tr.note: 'Viewer' tek tek izleyen kişilerdir: 'five million viewers'. 'Audience' izleyicilerin hepsini tek bir topluluk olarak anlatır: 'a large audience', 'the audience in the theater'.

quiz.cloze: The show was watched by over five million ______ last night.
